question: Does a laser with a saturable absorber, whose threshold is first order, choose the sign of its field as a weak bias dictates?

provenance.source: Salomaa and Stenholm, Phys. Rev. A 8, 2695 (1973); Scott, Sargent and Cantrell, Opt. Commun. 15, 13 (1975): laser with a saturable absorber, first-order threshold

name: laser with a saturable absorber
closure: one cavity mode with a real amplitude; gain and absorption follow the intensity adiabatically (class A); the absorber saturates s times more easily than the gain
